title: Ranger Bill
paragraphs: A family adventure series centered on Ranger Bill Jefferson and his team as they handle rescues, wilderness emergencies, crime, and moral challenges, produced by the Moody Bible Institute.

Moody Bible Institute Christian family-adventure drama centered on forest ranger Bill Jefferson in Knotty Pine. Some general references extend production to 1964, while specialist chronology ends its dated run in May 1962.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Local WMBI 15-minute era (October 2, 1950 to April 13, 1954) on [[org|org.52b7244a632bcbda|WMBI]] and Thirty-minute Moody syndication era (April 14, 1954 to May 19, 1962) on [[org|org.52b7244a632bcbda|WMBI]].
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.33ebafaa69470671|Moody Bible Institute]] and [[org|org.52b7244a632bcbda|WMBI]].

The stories often return to forestry and ranger work, transportation emergencies, wildlife encounters, wilderness rescue and protection, youth responsibility and growing up, and fire prevention and wildfire danger.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Moody expansion of children's religious radio drama, Mid-century religious-radio syndication, and Postwar family adventure, conservation and public-safety storytelling.
